# SheetLaunch

SheetLaunch is a desktop productivity app that opens Excel, Word, PowerPoint and CSV files in the matching Google Sheets, Docs or Slides editor.

## Product
- Website: https://sheetlaunch.getwalksafe.co.uk/
- Windows download: https://github.com/Michael5565/SheetLaunch-releases/releases/latest/download/SheetLaunch_0.1.1_x64_en-US.msi
- Users sign in with Google and choose SheetLaunch from Windows Open with.
- With file reuse enabled, the app can reopen an existing Google Drive copy instead of creating a duplicate.

## Privacy
Selected files are sent to the user's connected Google Drive for conversion. SheetLaunch does not sell or retain document contents on its own servers.

## Support
The website contains the current privacy and terms information.
